issue.title: Bead detail neighborhood scans every issue ID and link_provenance row, so detail reads scale with corpus size
issue.description:
`sase bead read`/`show` detail reads still scale with corpus size because the cached
artifact-link neighborhood scans every issue ID and every link-provenance row.

Proposed by phase bead sase-1h8.14 (perf gate, PROPOSED FOLLOW-UP note #4); routed here
by the sase-1h8 land agent with the root cause pinned.

Evidence (sase-1h8.14): the `bead_show_issue_detail` binding goes from ~6 ms at 1x to
~23.5 ms at 4x, while plain `bead_show` stays flat (0.6 -> 0.8 ms). Gate misses:
ratio:detail (3.7x in clean probes) and abs:point-read (25 ms at 4x vs the 20 ms
ceiling).

Root cause (sase-core, `crates/sase_core/src/bead/read_model/queries.rs`):
`neighborhood_in`, called from `detail_in` whenever `include_links` is true, runs
`SELECT id FROM issues` into a BTreeSet (all issues). It then iterates
`SELECT ... FROM link_provenance` with no WHERE clause (all provenance rows) and calls
`row_touches_in` per row, which can run `resolve_in` for each `bead:` ref. The
`link_provenance_target` index exists but is unused. Epic plan
`plan:202610/bead_store_history_independent_performance.md`, phase read-model-queries,
called for "provenance-by-target rows, which also fixes the O(links x issues)
row_touches_bead resolution."

Fix sketch: restrict the scan to rows that can touch the issue. Use rows whose
`target_ref` is one of the forms that resolve to it (`bead:<full id>`, plus
`bead:<suffix>` when that suffix resolves uniquely to it), or whose source is the issue
or one of those forms. Check survival with point lookups instead of loading every ID.
If shorthand resolution makes that unsafe, add an indexed resolved-target column,
maintained by rebuild, tail and write-through, and bump the read-model schema version.
Parity: `bead_read_model_parity` and the detail-view replay oracle must stay identical.
Then drop `ratio:detail` and `abs:point-read` from the `bead-perf-scale-gate`
`--gate-allow` list.

task_type_fields.impact:
Every audited `sase bead read`, `sase bead show`, and TUI detail view pays a cost that
is linear in all issues plus all link-provenance rows. It misses the warm point-read
ceiling (20 ms) at 4x and grows with closed history.
task_type_fields.repro:
.venv/bin/python tests/perf/bench_bead_scale.py --scale 1 --scale 4 --runs 5 --only show_detail_open --check-gate
# compare bead_show_issue_detail vs bead_show timings; read neighborhood_in in sase-core read_model/queries.rs

issue.creation_reason: Perf gate sase-1h8.14 (PROPOSED FOLLOW-UP #4) found detail reads scaling; the sase-1h8 land agent pinned the cause to read_model neighborhood_in's unfiltered scans, which the epic plan meant to replace with provenance-by-target rows.
